_toolsNote: t45: every tool the collector resolves is PINNED here on purpose. Without these keys src/collect.ps1 resolves netstat/netsh/powercfg/tailscale from the real machine (registry, Program Files, PATH) - -NoNative does not gate that - so on a fresh server with no Tailscale the tailscale layer short-circuits to blocked/ts_not_installed and six cases that expect an injected CLI verdict or exitCode 1 fail. The paths are identities, not machine facts: in fixture mode a declared probe is never executed, so only the 'is it installed' branch reads them.
_comment: Synthetic, fully offline baseline used by many tests/cases/*.json layers. It is a HAPPY server-side machine: no real machine value is embedded (see tests/cases/README.md, section 'why no real value appears here'). Tool text is English here; _base/server-zh.json carries the same state with Chinese tool text.

internet_settings._note: t49: the clean-host baseline has the system proxy OFF; the four-quadrant cases layer this block to turn it on
